verdicts.explanation: Section 3.2 states that at 850 K the computed conductivity of the α-phase rises from 6.12×10−4 S·cm−1 at x=0. The value is computed in this paper by MTP-MD, and the temperature conversion to 576.85 °C is correct.
The paper reports the α-phase conductivity rising to 1.60×10−3 S·cm−1 at 850 K as x goes from 0 to 0.1875. The record's material and value match, and the computed origin is correct.
The paper states that in the β-phase the conductivity rises from 1.10×10−3 S·cm−1 at x=1 to 2.78×10−3 at x=0.6875, at 850 K. The record matches that and is computed in this paper.
The paper gives 2.78×10−3 S·cm−1 at 850 K for the β-phase composition x=0.6875. The record matches, and the origin is computed in this paper.

The 4.2×10−6 S cm−1 value for partially crystallized Li56Nb22Ta22 is attributed to Yada et al. in the Introduction, so literature_cited is correct. The paper gives no measurement temperature, so null is correct.

The Introduction attributes 38.7×10−6 S cm−1 for partially crystallized LiNb0.5Ta0.5O3 to Wang et al. (ref 32), so literature_cited is correct. No measurement temperature is given, so null is correct.
